scope: Single saved-checkpoint CPU fork, 32 real continuing OWT targets plus 32 immediate fresh targets; no production changes or new training arm

hypotheses.prediction: Full/common predictive difference stays small despite motor variation, and actual R/decoder displacement has predominantly common-gradient inner product.
Head update improves effective common NLL while conditional gain remains small; excess over fixed train-only unigram can persist.
Saved-Adam displacement can oppose the current gradient, or first-order predicted gain disagrees with finite hard-spike replay; measure both before blaming missing capacity.

registered_update: Full parameter coverage of both existing AdamW optimizers with stored moments/steps/LR/betas/eps/decay, global norm clip1, postupdate excitatory/inhibitory edge clamp0..5; all existing STP params included when enabled
state_rules: Fitted replay starts at saved complete initial state; fresh comparison starts at the common old-parameter terminal after first32, matching production. No reset/burn-in substitution.
measures: Full/common and fixed previous128-event common scores; mean/covariance linear gradient identities; actual rounded optimizer displacement inner products; 2x2 body/head crossed scores; hard-spike support changes
stop: Exactly one joint update on a fork. No additional training based on this result alone.
review: diagnosis_review reviewed plan and identified coverage, checkpoint recomputation purity, surrogate discontinuity and retrospective-common interpretation requirements
